profile.name: Sophia Alemar
profile.title: Graphic designer · Maryland-born · 19
profile.bio: I have always loved art and exploring new ways to express myself. I originally applied to Graphic Design on a whim, but it quickly became something I genuinely enjoy. It lets me stay creative and professional while including my hobbies without burning myself out.
